sentences.text:
VIVEK LODHI S/O SHRI MAGANLAL LODHI, AGED  ABOUT 31 YEARS, OCCUPATION: COACHING CENTER  R/O VILLAGE PINDRAI PS. BHEDAGHAT DISTT.
 JABALPUR (M.P.)
 
 (BY SHRI P. P. BUDHOLIYA - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION BHEDAGHAT, DISTRICT JABALPUR (M.P.)
 
 (BY SHRI CHRISTOPHER ANTHONY - PANEL LAWYER)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant who has been arrested relating to FIR/Crime No.231/2023 dated 24.04.2023 registered at Police Station Bhedaghat, district Jabalpur, for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 450 and 506 of IPC read with Section 3, 4, and 5 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 25.04.2023.
The applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.

The applicant is a permanent resident of district and there is no likelihood of his absconding or tampering with prosecution case;
he is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by this Court.
The trial will take considerable time to be concluded.
Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case-diary.
In this case, a minor prosecutrix complained that the applicant, who was her coaching teacher committed repeated sexual assault upon her and had taken the photographs of those episodes.

The statements of prosecutrix have been recorded before the trial Court, certified copy whereof is enclosed with this bail application, in which the prosecutrix has not supported even a single fact against the applicant and she has admitted that the applicant is the husband of her real sister.

Looking to these facts and also considering the delay of almost six months in lodging the FIR, this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail, therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of the trial.

It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE rv Vivek Lodhi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104765725/
